intro: Before anything else. Demo mode is the safe place to run most of this script.
title: Open the app and see the mode badge
steps: Open the AutoBets address in a browser.
expected: The header badge reads DEMO — FAKE PRICES or PRACTICE MODE. It never reads LIVE.

intro: Before anything else. Demo mode is the safe place to run most of this script.
title: Token prompt appears when no token is stored
steps: Open the app in a private window.
Do not enter a token.
expected: A token prompt is shown. Nothing else is usable.

intro: Before anything else. Demo mode is the safe place to run most of this script.
title: Wrong token is refused
steps: Enter a wrong token and submit.
expected: A clear 'try again' message. No market list loads.

intro: Before anything else. Demo mode is the safe place to run most of this script.
title: Right token is accepted and remembered
steps: Enter the right token.
Reload the page.
expected: Markets load. The token is not asked for again on reload.

intro: Before anything else. Demo mode is the safe place to run most of this script.
title: Backend unreachable shows a message, not a blank page
steps: Stop the service (or disconnect the network) and reload.
expected: A readable error with a Try again button.

intro: The left-hand market list and what opening a market does.
title: Tennis and Football tabs list markets
steps: Click Tennis, then Football.
expected: Each tab lists its own matches with competition and start time.

intro: The left-hand market list and what opening a market does.
title: Opening a market opens ALL its runners together
steps: Click a tennis match.
expected: Two ladders (A and B) appear in one market block, side by side.

intro: The left-hand market list and what opening a market does.
title: Football match odds opens three ladders
steps: Click the football match with a draw.
expected: Three ladders open: home, away and the draw, in one block.

intro: The left-hand market list and what opening a market does.
title: Four-ladder cap with a clear message
steps: Open the football match (3 ladders).
Open a tennis match (needs 2).
expected: A message says it needs 2 ladders but only 1 slot is free. Nothing half-opens.

intro: The left-hand market list and what opening a market does.
title: Opening the same market twice is refused
steps: Open a market.
Click the same market again.
expected: A message says it is already open. No duplicate ladders.

intro: The left-hand market list and what opening a market does.
title: Closing one market with the X closes all its ladders
steps: Click the X at the top right of a market block.
expected: All ladders of that market close together. You cannot close just one runner's ladder.

intro: The left-hand market list and what opening a market does.
title: Closing a market with a position or open orders asks first
steps: Place a bet and leave an unmatched bet.
Click the market's X.
expected: A confirm dialog warns about the position and the unmatched orders. Cancel keeps the market open.

intro: How a ladder looks and what each column means (Bet Angel is the reference).
title: Column order and colours
steps: Look at any ladder.
expected: Left to right: P&L column, my back bets, back (blue), price (dark blue), lay (pink), my lay bets, recent volume.

intro: How a ladder looks and what each column means (Bet Angel is the reference).
title: Back is blue and on the left, lay is pink and on the right
steps: Hover each side and read the tooltips.
expected: Left cells say 'Back at x', right cells say 'Lay at x'.

intro: How a ladder looks and what each column means (Bet Angel is the reference).
title: Back prices sit at or below the best back; lay prices at or above the best lay
steps: Compare the blue and pink cells with the price column.
expected: Blue numbers appear on prices up to the best back price; pink numbers from the best lay price upwards; one tick between them when the spread is a tick.

intro: How a ladder looks and what each column means (Bet Angel is the reference).
title: Tinted empty zones
steps: Look at the empty cells beyond the best prices.
expected: Empty cells in the back zone and the lay zone are tinted; cells in between are plain.

intro: How a ladder looks and what each column means (Bet Angel is the reference).
title: Last traded price is highlighted
steps: Find the orange outlined price.
expected: The last traded price row is outlined in orange and updates as the market moves.

intro: How a ladder looks and what each column means (Bet Angel is the reference).
title: Recent volume column
steps: Watch the right-hand bars for a minute.
expected: Bars show volume matched at each price in the short window (solid) and long window (lighter). Numbers appear for the short window.

intro: How a ladder looks and what each column means (Bet Angel is the reference).
title: Total matched column (optional)
steps: Ladder settings → show the total matched column.
expected: An extra column appears with the total matched at each price. Switching it off removes it.

intro: How a ladder looks and what each column means (Bet Angel is the reference).
title: Weight of money bar
steps: Look at the bar above the ladder.
expected: Blue and pink shares add to 100%, with an arrow showing which side is heavier, and the number of bets each side.

intro: How a ladder looks and what each column means (Bet Angel is the reference).
title: Footer shows matched volume and market share
steps: Look at the line under the price rows.
expected: It shows £ matched on that runner and its % of the market. If Betfair sends none it says 'volume not available' (expected on a delayed key).

intro: How a ladder looks and what each column means (Bet Angel is the reference).
title: Light and dark themes
steps: Click Dark / Light in the header.
expected: Both themes are readable: colours, price column, chips and panels.

intro: Scrolling, recentring and reversing the ladder.
title: Mouse wheel moves the prices
steps: Hover the price rows and use the wheel.
expected: The ladder moves up and down the price ladder one tick per notch.

intro: Scrolling, recentring and reversing the ladder.
title: Wheel outside the price rows does not move prices
steps: Hover the chart or the header and use the wheel.
expected: The prices do not move.

intro: Scrolling, recentring and reversing the ladder.
title: Ladder stays put when the price moves (auto-centre off)
steps: Leave auto-centre off.
Wait for the price to drift.
expected: The ladder holds its position and shows ▲ or ▼ with the price when the market has moved out of view.

intro: Scrolling, recentring and reversing the ladder.
title: Recentre with Enter and the ⌖ button
steps: Scroll away, then press Enter.
Scroll away, then click ⌖ on one ladder.
expected: Enter recentres every ladder; ⌖ recentres just that one.

intro: Scrolling, recentring and reversing the ladder.
title: Auto-centre setting
steps: Ladder settings → auto-recentre on.
Let the price drift.
expected: The ladder follows the price by itself.

intro: Scrolling, recentring and reversing the ladder.
title: Reverse ladders (R key and button)
steps: Press R, then press it again.
expected: Lowest price moves to the top, then back. Back stays on the left and lay on the right; clicking still places the side of the column you clicked.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Preset stake buttons
steps: Click 2, 5, 10, 20 in the toolbar.
expected: The chosen preset is highlighted and used for the next bet.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Free-form stake box
steps: Press S, type 65, press Enter.
expected: The stake box shows 65 and the next bet is £65. Clearing the box goes back to the preset.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Pound sign and commas accepted
steps: Type £1,250 in the stake box.
expected: It is read as £1,250.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Stakes under £1 are refused
steps: Type 0.50 in the stake box and click a price.
expected: A message says the minimum is £1. No bet is placed.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Invalid text is flagged
steps: Type abc in the stake box.
expected: The box turns red with 'min £1'. Clicking a price places nothing.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Per-ladder stake
steps: On one ladder click a stake chip or type in its own stake box.
Place a bet on each ladder.
expected: Each ladder uses its own stake. A ladder with an empty box uses the toolbar stake.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Number keys 1–8 act on the hovered ladder
steps: Hover one ladder and press 3.
expected: That ladder's stake becomes the 3rd preset. The other ladder is unchanged. With no ladder hovered it changes the toolbar stake.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Lay stake or liability
steps: Ladder settings → lay stakes entered as liability.
Stake 10, lay at 3.0.
expected: The bet placed is a lay of £5 (liability £10). Switching back to 'a stake' lays £10.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Confirm large orders
steps: Set 'confirm orders of £50 or more'.
Bet £60.
expected: A confirm card shows side, runner, price and size. Place sends it; Cancel (or Esc) does not.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Percentage-of-bank stakes
steps: Settings → stakes as % of bank; bank £500.
Look at the preset chips; click a 4% chip and place a bet.
expected: Chips show %; a 4% bet is £20.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Type 2% in a stake box
steps: With bank £500 type 2% in the stake box.
expected: The next bet is £10, whatever the stake mode.

intro: Every way of choosing how much to bet.
title: Separate lay stake
steps: Settings → separate stake for lay bets.
Enter a lay stake of 20, back stake 10.
expected: A Lay £ box appears. Back bets use £10, lay bets use £20. Blank lay box uses the back stake.

intro: Clicks, sides, prices and what 'matched' means.
title: Click blue = BACK, click pink = LAY
steps: Click a blue cell, then a pink cell, both with stake £2.
expected: Confirmation says BACK (blue tag) then LAY (pink tag) at the prices you clicked. The Matched bets panel lists them with the same sides.

intro: Clicks, sides, prices and what 'matched' means.
title: A bet at the best price matches immediately
steps: Click the best back price (the highest blue number).
expected: Status 'matched'. Your position line appears.

intro: Clicks, sides, prices and what 'matched' means.
title: A bet at a worse price takes the better price
steps: Click a lay cell above the best lay price.
expected: The bet matches at the best lay price, not the price you clicked. The Matched bets panel shows both 'Asked' and 'Matched at'.

intro: Clicks, sides, prices and what 'matched' means.
title: A bet at a better price waits (unmatched)
steps: Lay at a price well below the best back, or back at a price well above the best lay.
expected: Status 'waiting (unmatched)'. It appears in Unmatched bets and on the ladder.

intro: Clicks, sides, prices and what 'matched' means.
title: Waiting bets are summed at their price
steps: Place three £10 lays at the same low price.
expected: That row shows '£30 ×3' in your own-bets column and 'LAY £30 waiting' over the volume bar; BACK shows blue. Hover shows the count and total.

intro: Clicks, sides, prices and what 'matched' means.
title: A waiting bet matches when the price reaches it
steps: Wait with a lay waiting just below the market until the price drops to it (or place it one tick away).
expected: The bet moves from Unmatched bets to Matched bets and your position updates.

intro: Clicks, sides, prices and what 'matched' means.
title: Price steps follow Betfair's tick sizes
steps: Place a waiting bet near 2.00 and press + or − repeatedly across 2.00 and across 3.00.
expected: Steps are 0.01 below 2.00, 0.02 from 2.00 to 3.00 and 0.05 from 3.00 to 4.00. Only valid Betfair prices ever appear.

intro: Clicks, sides, prices and what 'matched' means.
title: Double-click mode
steps: Settings → clicking → double click.
Single-click a price, then double-click one.
expected: A single click places nothing; a double click places one bet.

intro: Clicks, sides, prices and what 'matched' means.
title: Toast tags make the side obvious
steps: Place a back and a lay.
expected: Each confirmation shows BACK in blue or LAY in pink.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: Cancel a waiting bet by clicking it on the ladder
steps: Click your own-bet chip.
expected: The bet disappears from the ladder and from Unmatched bets.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: Drag a waiting bet to a new price
steps: Drag the chip to another price row.
expected: The bet moves to the new price; with several bets at one price they all move.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: Unmatched panel lists every waiting bet
steps: Place two waiting bets on different runners.
expected: Both appear with side, runner, placed time, price, stake, matched and at-the-off setting.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: ± tick buttons change the price
steps: Click + then − on a waiting bet.
expected: The price moves one valid tick each time; the bet stays waiting.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: Edit the stake in place
steps: Change the stake in the panel and press Enter.
expected: The waiting amount changes. Anything already matched is untouched.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: Cancel and Cancel all
steps: Cancel one bet, then press Cancel all.
expected: One bet cancels; then all remaining waiting bets cancel.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: Cancel back / cancel lay hotkeys
steps: Hover a ladder with a waiting back and lay; press Z, then X.
expected: Z cancels that runner's waiting backs; X cancels its waiting lays.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: At-the-off setting per bet and for all
steps: Choose Keep / Cancel / Take SP on a bet.
Use the 'At the off, all' buttons.
expected: The selection changes immediately and is shown in the table.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: At the off: Cancel lapses the bet
steps: Set a waiting bet to Cancel.
Use Demo controls → Go in play.
expected: The waiting bet is cancelled when the market goes in play.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: At the off: Keep leaves the bet on
steps: Set a waiting bet to Keep.
Go in play.
expected: The bet stays waiting in play.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: At the off: Take SP removes the bet (practice does not simulate SP)
steps: Set Take SP and go in play.
expected: The bet leaves the list. (Starting Price is not simulated in practice.)

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: Default 'at the off' setting
steps: Settings → unmatched bets when the match starts: choose Cancel / Keep / Take SP; place a waiting bet.
expected: The new bet starts with the chosen setting.

section: Waiting bets: cancel, move, edit, persistence
intro: Managing unmatched bets (the 'Unmatched bets' panel and the ladder).
title: Fill or kill
steps: Settings → fill or kill 10 seconds.
Place a waiting bet and wait.
expected: After about 10 seconds the unmatched part is cancelled and the log says so.

intro: What the screen says you have and what it is worth.
title: Position in words
steps: Lay £10 on a runner.
expected: The ladder shows a pink 'LAY £10.00 @ price' tag, then 'if <runner> wins -£x · if <runner> loses +£10.00'.

intro: What the screen says you have and what it is worth.
title: Back position wording
steps: Back £10 on a runner.
expected: A blue 'BACK £10.00 @ price' tag; profit if it wins, -£10 if it loses.

intro: What the screen says you have and what it is worth.
title: The numbers are right for a lay
expected: If the runner wins you lose £5.00; if it loses you win £10.00.

intro: What the screen says you have and what it is worth.
title: P&L column shows what hedging at each price would lock
steps: With a position, read the left column.
expected: For a lay it rises as the price rises; for a back it falls. Green is profit, red is loss.

intro: What the screen says you have and what it is worth.
title: Clicking a P&L figure places the hedge
steps: Click a figure in the P&L column.
expected: The hedging bet is placed (side and stake shown in the tooltip), locking that figure.

intro: What the screen says you have and what it is worth.
title: P&L basis: runner or market
steps: Toolbar chip 'P&L: runner' → market. Compare the column on a 3-runner market.
expected: Runner mode shows this runner's lock; market mode shows the worst case across all runners after that hedge. On a 2-runner market they match.

intro: What the screen says you have and what it is worth.
title: P&L column on the left or right
steps: Settings → P&L column on the right.
expected: The column moves to the right edge. Clicking behaves the same.

intro: What the screen says you have and what it is worth.
title: Close a runner
steps: Press Close on a ladder (or C).
expected: The runner's position is closed with a hedging bet. The Close button is disabled with no position.

intro: What the screen says you have and what it is worth.
title: Cancel a runner's orders from the ladder
steps: Press Cancel on a ladder with waiting bets.
expected: All that runner's waiting bets cancel.

intro: What the screen says you have and what it is worth.
title: Matched bets panel
steps: Place several bets, back and lay.
expected: Each appears newest first with time, side, runner, asked price, matched price, stake, 'Runner wins', 'Runner loses' and who placed it.

intro: What the screen says you have and what it is worth.
title: Header total P&L and exposure
steps: Look at the top right with a position.
expected: A P&L chip and the exposure update as positions change.

section: Market block header and the big button
intro: The Geeks Toy-style market panel above the ladders.
title: Clock, status and book percentages
steps: Look at a market block header.
expected: Pre-match shows a countdown; in play shows 'In play'. Back and lay book percentages are shown either side of the button.

section: Market block header and the big button
intro: The Geeks Toy-style market panel above the ladders.
title: Outcome boxes
steps: With a position look at the two (or three) boxes.
expected: One box per runner shows your profit or loss if that runner wins.

section: Market block header and the big button
intro: The Geeks Toy-style market panel above the ladders.
title: The big button shows the market P&L
steps: Hold a position and watch the button.
expected: Green when the market is at or above £0.00, red below. It always shows the figure, including after it is pressed.

section: Market block header and the big button
intro: The Geeks Toy-style market panel above the ladders.
title: Hard close
steps: Click the big button (or press G).
expected: Waiting bets cancel, then the bets that level every outcome are placed. The button then shows the locked figure.

section: Market block header and the big button
intro: The Geeks Toy-style market panel above the ladders.
title: Soft green keeping waiting bets
steps: Open the ▾ menu → green up, keep my unmatched bets.
expected: The market is levelled but waiting bets stay.

section: Market block header and the big button
intro: The Geeks Toy-style market panel above the ladders.
title: Partial hedge
steps: Menu → 50%.
expected: About half of the hedge is placed; outcomes are closer but not level; waiting bets stay.

section: Market block header and the big button
intro: The Geeks Toy-style market panel above the ladders.
title: Auto-green at a profit level
steps: Menu → enter a level above the current figure → Set.
Wait for the market to reach it.
expected: A chip 'Auto-green at £x' shows. When the level is reached the market hard-closes. Click the chip to remove it.

section: Market block header and the big button
intro: The Geeks Toy-style market panel above the ladders.
title: Right-click the big button
steps: Right-click it.
expected: The same menu opens.

section: Market block header and the big button
intro: The Geeks Toy-style market panel above the ladders.
title: Big button with no position
steps: Look at the button with nothing matched.
expected: It is greyed out; nothing happens when clicked.

intro: Triggers set from the ladder.
title: Right-click a price on a ladder with a position
steps: Right-click a price below (or above) the market.
expected: A menu offers 'Stop loss' or 'Take profit' at that price, showing what it would lock.

intro: Triggers set from the ladder.
title: A stop shows on the ladder
steps: Set one.
expected: An 'SL' or 'TP' marker appears at that price in your own-bets column.

intro: Triggers set from the ladder.
title: A trigger fires and greens up
steps: Set a take profit one or two ticks away and wait.
expected: When the last price reaches it, the runner is greened up and the log says so.

intro: Triggers set from the ladder.
title: Remove a stop
steps: Click its marker, or use the right-click menu 'Remove'.
expected: The marker disappears and it never fires.

intro: Triggers set from the ladder.
title: A stop waits while the market is suspended
steps: Set a stop.
Suspend the market via Demo controls.
expected: It does not fire while suspended; it resumes when the market reopens.

intro: Bets that place their own closing bet and stop.
title: Offset places the closing bet
steps: Toolbar Offset 3.
Back £10 at the best back.
expected: When it matches, a LAY for the equalising stake is placed 3 ticks away (shown waiting). The log says 'Offset: …'.

intro: Bets that place their own closing bet and stop.
title: Stop is armed on entry
steps: Offset 3 and Stop 4.
Place a back.
expected: A stop is armed 4 ticks against the entry price (an 'SL' marker). The log says 'Stop armed'.

intro: Bets that place their own closing bet and stop.
title: Stop fires and cancels the offset bet
steps: Let the price move 4 ticks against you.
expected: The position is closed and the waiting offset bet is cancelled.

intro: Bets that place their own closing bet and stop.
title: Offset matching removes the stop
steps: Let the price move 3 ticks in your favour.
expected: The offset bet matches, the position is closed and the stop disappears.

intro: Bets that place their own closing bet and stop.
title: Offset applies to lays as well
steps: Offset 3; lay £10.
expected: A BACK is placed 3 ticks above the lay price.

intro: Bets that place their own closing bet and stop.
title: Offset and stop from settings
steps: Set the same values in Ladder settings.
expected: The toolbar boxes show the same numbers (they are one setting).

intro: Bets that place their own closing bet and stop.
title: Zero means off
steps: Set both to 0 and bet.
expected: No extra orders are placed.

intro: Suspended, closed, removed runners and the start of play.
title: Suspended market blocks betting
steps: Demo controls → Suspend.
expected: A banner says SUSPENDED; ladders dim; clicking places nothing; the status tag shows.

intro: Suspended, closed, removed runners and the start of play.
title: Reopen resumes trading
steps: Demo controls → Reopen.
expected: The banner clears and bets work again.

intro: Suspended, closed, removed runners and the start of play.
title: Closed market
steps: Demo controls → Close.
expected: MARKET CLOSED banner; no bets, no green-up.

intro: Suspended, closed, removed runners and the start of play.
title: Hard close refuses on a suspended market
steps: Suspend, then press the big button.
expected: A message explains the market is suspended; nothing is placed.

intro: Suspended, closed, removed runners and the start of play.
title: Going in play
steps: Pre-match → Go in play.
expected: The header changes to 'In play'; waiting bets follow their at-the-off setting.

intro: Suspended, closed, removed runners and the start of play.
title: Waiting bets do not match while suspended
steps: Place a waiting bet near the market, suspend, wait, reopen.
expected: It does not fill during the suspension.

intro: The chart under each ladder.
title: Chart shows price and volume
steps: Look under a ladder.
expected: A line for the last price, a band between best back and lay, volume bars, and the last price tag.

intro: The chart under each ladder.
title: Time ranges
steps: Click 5m, 15m, 1h, 3h.
expected: The window changes; the 'shown' label updates.

intro: The chart under each ladder.
title: History backfills for markets the price logger has seen
steps: Open a market the logger already tracks.
expected: The chart opens with earlier history (one point a minute), not empty.

intro: The chart under each ladder.
title: Drag the bar to resize
steps: Drag the grip under the price rows down, then up.
expected: Down adds price rows and shrinks the chart; up does the reverse.

intro: The chart under each ladder.
title: Each ladder resizes on its own
steps: Drag the right-hand ladder's bar.
expected: Only that ladder changes.

intro: The chart under each ladder.
title: The chart can be shrunk away completely
steps: Drag the bar all the way down.
expected: The chart disappears; only the grip remains. Drag back up to restore it.

intro: The chart under each ladder.
title: No scrollbar inside a ladder
steps: Resize the browser window taller and shorter.
expected: The ladder always fits; it never shows its own scrollbar; chart and rows share the space.

intro: The chart under each ladder.
title: Rows setting
steps: Settings → price rows 0 (auto), then 15.
expected: 0 fits the window and leaves room for a chart; 15 fixes the count (capped to what fits).

intro: The chart under each ladder.
title: Chart on/off
steps: Settings → show chart off.
expected: The chart and its drag bar disappear from every ladder.

intro: Keyboard control.
title: Default keys
steps: Hover a ladder and try S, Z, X, C, G, R, Enter, 1–8.
expected: S stake box; Z cancel backs; X cancel lays; C close runner; G hard close market; R reverse; Enter recentre; 1–8 stake presets.

intro: Keyboard control.
title: Keys are ignored while typing in a box
steps: Click a text box and type z, x, c.
expected: No bets or cancels happen.

intro: Keyboard control.
title: Rebind a key
steps: Settings → hotkeys → click 'Hard close' → press H.
expected: The box shows H; pressing H now hard-closes; the help line under the toolbar shows H.

intro: Keyboard control.
title: Conflicting keys are refused
steps: Try to give two actions the same key.
expected: A message names the action already using that key; nothing changes.

intro: Keyboard control.
title: Reset to defaults restores keys
steps: Settings → Reset to defaults.
expected: Keys return to S, Z, X, C, G, R, Enter.

intro: Every option in the settings dialog.
title: Settings dialog opens and closes
steps: Click Ladder settings; press Done; reopen; press Esc.
expected: It opens, closes with Done and with Esc.

intro: Every option in the settings dialog.
title: Settings are remembered
steps: Change a few settings and reload.
expected: They are still set (stored in this browser).

intro: Every option in the settings dialog.
title: Recent volume windows
steps: Set short 30s, long 10 minutes.
expected: The recent volume column's tooltip and bars reflect the new windows.

intro: Every option in the settings dialog.
title: Weight of money levels
steps: Change WoM levels to 1, then 5.
expected: The WoM percentages change.

intro: Every option in the settings dialog.
title: Stake presets editable
steps: Change the preset list.
expected: The toolbar and per-ladder chips show the new presets; keys 1–8 follow.

intro: Every option in the settings dialog.
title: Reset to defaults
steps: Press Reset to defaults and confirm.
expected: Every setting returns to its default; the Cancel on the confirm leaves things alone.

intro: Every option in the settings dialog.
title: Save a layout
steps: Name it 'Tennis scalping' and press Save current settings.
expected: It appears in the saved list.

intro: Every option in the settings dialog.
title: Load a layout
steps: Change settings, then press Load on the saved layout.
expected: Settings return to what was saved.

intro: Every option in the settings dialog.
title: Delete a layout
steps: Delete it and confirm.
expected: It disappears.

intro: Every option in the settings dialog.
title: Layouts survive a reload
steps: Reload.
expected: Saved layouts are still listed.

intro: The ⇄ control in a ladder's header.
